meta.money_note: All monetary values (overhead, rates, costs) are written here in INR; the seeder converts them to the base currency (config/currency.php, rate 85) before saving.
meta.match_note: Rows are matched on their code (never on a fixed id), so re-running updates these rows without overwriting other data. Keys starting with '_' are notes for people and are not saved.
